result: The current owned engine changes explain their essential performance and lifetime invariants. No missing comment blocks the current trial. One optional cache-miss policy clarification would help future optimization work; it is proposed below without changing sources.

preserved_explanations.invariant: sorted owns its formal key before iteration and retains it through comparisons, output replacement and cleanup. The explanation prevents reintroducing a collection-only lifetime pin or the rejected Interpreter wrapper lease.

Liveness proof construction and CAS retry stay in the cold separate translation unit, while cached metadata access remains in the frame header. The constructor-only whitelist comment explains why unsupported/fused/handler/iterator paths retain arguments.

A fresh constructor self is locally owned; only proven dead explicit arguments move. This preserves finalizer timing without adding general per-opcode retirement or changing ordinary function transfer.
Inherited handled exception state is seeded once at normal native/embedding entry. Generator/pause policy and opcode hot paths retain their existing behavior.

Process-wide class versions identify lifetime and attribute state, preventing pointer-address reuse from validating a non-owning cache. The class-owned constructor record explicitly contains no Python owners.

Original own slot declarations and explicit layout origin are immutable history; mutable __slots__, flattened layout and descriptor deletion cannot manufacture proof. Inferred/native storage keeps its legacy fallback.

Explicit-slot IR retains dynamic stores. Only complete own canonical descriptor proof converts names into physical indices; deleting a restricted-layout guard alone is unsafe. Duplicate physical stores and unused arguments decline to preserve finalizer boundaries.
The complete plan is validated before writes into fresh Invalid slots; unsupported state must have no side effect.

Persistent publication follows successful ordinary selection and full own-slot proof. Absent abstract/enum entries are stable under generations; empty mutable marker containers are not a negative certificate.
Default native __new__ is stored in an exact StaticMethod. Direct stored-target inspection avoids executing descriptors or admitting wrapped Python functions during publication.

Runtime class/type/object identities and live generations are checked before weak initializer dereference. Current owning __init__ identity covers isolated class collection that clears cyclic attrs without retagging. Argument validation precedes speculative allocation, and a transient initializer owner survives old-output finalizers.
Class-owned plans survive short callback frames without Python roots; after completed output publication no borrowed class plan, initializer or argument is revisited.

Profile settings are current-thread settings, not restored frame settings. Old owners are unpublished before new mirrors are published, then retired after publication; this confines work to the cold setter and tolerates reentry.

Successful synthetic class frames release their own namespace before decorators, while escaped locals/frames and annotation closures keep independent owners. Explicit register replacement is required because Pop is a no-op and conservative loop liveness can otherwise retain it.
Source cache generation changes for lowering semantics and owner lifetimes as well as IR encoding/layout changes; structurally valid old caches are not semantically valid after correction.

optional_clarification.suggested_comment: On a guard miss leave the scalar plan inert. It owns no Python values; replace it only after successful cold selection/proof, rather than adding cleanup and allocation to repeated misses.
optional_clarification.reason: The existing comments establish ownerlessness and weak-pointer guard order, but do not explicitly state why stale scalar nodes deliberately remain installed after a miss. This is a performance policy, not a new semantic requirement or acceptance blocker.

limits: This audits explanations only and does not certify performance gains or completed validation.

The rejected scoped Interpreter reuse, weak-module cache retention, tiny inline-buffer resizing and per-opcode retirement trials must not be restored merely because cleanup appears in a sampled range.

Lazy method annotations currently use the existing static alias/cell model. Forward/live class namespace mutation parity remains bounded future correctness work, not a completed guarantee of this checkpoint.
